issue.title: test_plugins_pane_lazy_fetches_highlighted_latest waits on the enrich call marker instead of the applied entry, so it loses the race under the parallel lane
issue.description:
`tests/ace/tui/test_plugins_browser_pane_detail.py::test_plugins_pane_lazy_fetches_highlighted_latest`
failed once under the full parallel `just test` lane and passed on an isolated
rerun of the same tree.

## Suspected root cause

The test gates on the wrong signal. `_fake_enrich` appends to `calls` and then
returns the enriched entry:

```python
def _fake_enrich(entry, **_kwargs):
    calls.append(entry.name)
    return replace(entry, latest=LatestInfo(checked=True, version="2.0.0", source="index"))
```

The body then waits only for that append:

```python
await page.wait_for(lambda _s: bool(calls))
entry = pane._entry_by_name("nvim")
assert entry.latest.version == "2.0.0"
```

`calls` is populated at the *start* of the enrich worker, before its return
value is posted back and applied to the pane's entry list. Under parallel-lane
scheduling the assertion can therefore observe the pre-enrichment entry, whose
`latest` is `LatestInfo.unknown()` (`version is None`) — exactly the observed
failure `assert None == '2.0.0'`. Serially the worker almost always lands first,
which is why it passes on rerun.

The fix is to wait on the applied state rather than the call marker, e.g.
`await page.wait_for(lambda _s: (e := pane._entry_by_name("nvim")) is not None
and e.latest.version == "2.0.0")`, keeping the `calls` assertion only as a
"was the lazy fetch attempted" check.

## Discovery

Found by `sase-sq.8.1.land` while running the full suite to verify epic
sase-sq.8.1 ("Retire the config glossary"). Not caused by that epic: its commits
touch glossary/memory/ACE-config-hub code and never
`src/sase/ace/tui/plugins_browser_pane*`, and the node passed in an earlier
full-suite run on a tree that already contained all three epic commits.

task_type_fields.evidence: 1 fail / 2 runs under the full parallel `just test` lane on master 882ba36f5 (plus in-scope working-tree edits): passed in the first full run, failed in the second with `AssertionError: assert None == 2.0.0` at line 225. Passed immediately on an isolated serial rerun of the same unchanged tree (`.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ace/tui/test_plugins_browser_pane_detail.py::test_plugins_pane_lazy_fetches_highlighted_latest`, 1 passed in 2.71s). Parallel-only so far; not observed serially.

payload.entry: Verified fixed by epic sase-th phase sase-th.6 (Fix the two remaining CI-only test races). tests/ace/tui/test_plugins_browser_pane_detail.py::test_plugins_pane_lazy_fetches_highlighted_latest now waits on the applied entry state instead of the enrich call marker; passed in just check-full's full test lane (run 7424qcad6bd8) and was independently verified serially and under SASE_PYTEST_WORKERS=4 per sase-th.6's close note.
